narrative:
Muskingum County has 53,123 registered voters, with 56.4% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 29.5% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 14.1%, a pronounced Republican lean of 15.4 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 29.1% of registrants.
